tag: 年終升遷審核指引備忘錄

level.why: 備忘錄含被動語態、關係子句與條件句，需整合評核原則、提名文件與時程；字彙為人資與升遷相關詞彙，句型長度中等，干擾項取自文中相近資訊。

passage:
To: All Department Managers
From: Human Resources
Subject: Guidelines for the Year-End Promotion Review

As the promotion review begins next week, managers are reminded to comply with the revised evaluation guidelines. Reviewers must adhere to the written criteria and must not be influenced by appearance, personal friendships, or length of service alone. Comments about a candidate's age or personal style are inappropriate and will be removed from the file.

Each nomination must include a reference letter from a senior executive who has worked with the candidate. In addition, candidates who are eager to move into a supervisory role should show practical experience in leading small projects. Even a novice team leader may be considered if the results are well documented.

Please submit all nominations to Human Resources by Friday, December 4. Late submissions cannot be reviewed until the next round in June.
zh:
收件人：各部門主管
寄件人：人力資源部
主旨：年終升遷審核指引

隨著升遷審核將於下週展開，提醒各位主管遵守修訂後的評核指引。審核人員必須依循書面標準，且不得僅受外表、私人交情或年資長短左右。關於候選人年齡或個人風格的評論並不恰當，將會從檔案中移除。

每份提名都必須附上一封由曾與該候選人共事的資深主管所出具的推薦信。此外，渴望晉升到督導職位的候選人，應展現帶領小型專案的實務經驗。即使是新手組長，只要成果有完整紀錄，也可能被納入考慮。

請在 12 月 4 日星期五前將所有提名送交人力資源部。逾期的提名要等到明年六月的下一輪才會審核。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the memo?
opts: To announce the results of a promotion review
To remind managers of the rules for evaluating candidates
To ask managers to recruit new team leaders
To explain a change in the salary structure
why: 錯誤：審核尚未開始，沒有公布結果。
正解：備忘錄提醒主管遵守修訂後的評核指引與提名規定。
錯誤：文中是提名現有員工，並非招募。
錯誤：文中沒有提到薪資制度的改變。

questions.q: What must be included with each nomination?
opts: A summary of last year's sales
A copy of the candidate's resume
A letter from the Human Resources director
A reference letter from a senior executive who knows the candidate's work
why: 錯誤：文中未要求去年銷售摘要。
錯誤：文中未要求履歷。
錯誤：推薦信須由曾與候選人共事的資深主管撰寫，不是人資主任。
正解：每份提名必須附上曾與候選人共事的資深主管所寫的推薦信。

questions.q: What does the memo suggest about a novice team leader?
opts: He or she may still be considered if the results are well documented
He or she cannot be nominated until the next round
He or she must first complete a training course
He or she should be nominated only by Human Resources
why: 正解：只要成果有完整紀錄，新手組長也可能被考慮。
錯誤：下一輪（六月）是針對逾期提名，並非針對新手。
錯誤：文中沒有提到需先完成培訓課程。
錯誤：文中沒有提到只能由人資提名。

questions.q: Employees who demonstrate strong ______ are more likely to be promoted to supervisory positions.
opts: leader
leading
leadership
lead
why: 錯誤：leader 為可數名詞單數，此處缺冠詞且語意為「領導者」。
錯誤：leading 為形容詞或分詞，語意不通。
正解：leadership 為不可數名詞，意為「領導力」，符合語意。
錯誤：lead 為動詞或名詞，語意與用法不符。

questions.q: The panel will review all applications ______ they are submitted before the deadline.
opts: in spite of
provided that
so as to
owing to
why: 錯誤：in spite of 後接名詞，且語意相反。
正解：provided that 引導條件子句，表示「只要」。
錯誤：so as to 後接動詞原形。
錯誤：owing to 後接名詞，不接子句。
